storylines.summary: Forged flanges from Turkey: confirmation with advance payment, weekend loading, a 14-hour border queue, an unloading slot and the arrival with two rusty crates.
storylines.editorNotes: Times in TRT (UTC+3), weekend mail from the supplier, dd/mm/yyyy dates, a CMR number, an unloading slot asked for in CET.

facts: 1,200 forged flanges DN100 PN16 at 14.80 EUR = 17,760.00 EUR
beats.subject: Purchase order PO-26-1088 - forged flanges DN100
beats.body:
Dear Mr Arslan,

please find our purchase order PO-26-1088:
1,200 pcs forged flange DN100 PN16 at 14.80 EUR = 17,760.00 EUR
Terms: FCA Bursa, ready for loading on 17 July 2026, payment as agreed (30 % advance, 70 % against CMR copy).

Kind regards
Alex Morgan
Head of Operations
Nordhafen Industriebedarf GmbH

beats.subject: RE: Purchase order PO-26-1088 - forged flanges DN100
beats.body:
Dear Mr Morgan,

Thank you very much for your valuable order. We are pleased to confirm your purchase order PO-26-1088 for 1,200 pcs forged flange DN100 PN16, total amount EUR 17,760.00, FCA Bursa.

The goods will be ready for loading on 17/07/2026. To start production we kindly ask for the 30 % advance payment of EUR 5,328.00 until 10/07/2026.

We thank you for your trust and remain at your disposal.

Best regards,
Mehmet Arslan
Export Manager
Anadolu Dövme Sanayi A.Ş.
Bursa / Türkiye
Tel: +90 224 5550 5501

tasks.title: Anzahlung 5.328,00 EUR für PO-26-1088 an Anadolu überweisen

beats.subject: RE: Purchase order PO-26-1088 - loading
beats.body:
Dear Mr Morgan,

loading of PO-26-1088 was completed today. Truck 34 BL 2207 (Bosporus Lojistik), CMR no. CMR-BL-260718, 1,200 pcs on 6 crates.
The truck will reach the Kapıkule border on Monday 20/07; estimated arrival in Hamburg 23/07/2026.

Best regards,
Elif Kaya
Logistics
Anadolu Dövme Sanayi A.Ş.
Tel: +90 224 5550 5502

storylines.summary: Fasteners from Spain by full truckload through France; separately, the supplier announces a price increase from August.
storylines.editorNotes: Dates as 14/07; the price increase is a separate thread and does not affect this PO (later invoices show the new price).

facts: prices up 6.5 % for all orders from 1 August 2026
beats.subject: Price adjustment from 1 August 2026
beats.body:
Dear customer,

due to the continued increase of steel prices and the new steel surcharge of our wire suppliers, we are forced to increase our prices by 6.5 % for all orders placed from 1 August 2026. Orders already confirmed, such as your PO-26-1091, are not affected.

The new price list will follow next week. We thank you for your understanding.

Un saludo,
Lucía Navarro
Export Department
Tornillería del Ebro S.L.
Tel. +34 976 5550 5201
